title: Homilies on Psalm 36, Homilia I
blurb: Origen’s Homilia I on Psalm 36 (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–3.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia I on Psalm 36 — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Trigg/Prinzivalli SC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Psalm 36 Homilia I §§1–3 (closeout). The English here is new.
